author: ANormalPenguin
body:
When I was banned in January I thought  I would be fine without Avicus. I have learned now that hacking is bad, I will never hack again. I have deleted my hacked clients and will never download them back.

I know now what I have down is wrong and I shouldn't have killed so many people using hacks, I shouldn't have said any bad things to staff. I am very sorry for everything I have done. I will from now on always be a good boy, do not unban me if u will but I just want every person I threatened or sweared at im truly sorry.

I remember when I played Avicus when it was just MCZone, the good times when like 30 people played, now 300 play. I wish I could be apart of the community again.

Plus - lilPupPlays is my new name, its not PsychoticBanana anymore ;)
